end.parentNote: Kavya practised converting repeated multiplication into exponential notation and evaluating powers. They explained that the base is the lower number and the exponent is the raised number, and they showed the repeated multiplication steps for 3⁴ = 81. There was a mix-up between 1,00,000 and 10,00,000 while naming powers of 10; it was corrected to six zeroes and 10,00,000 later in the lesson. At home, practise writing 10⁵ and 10⁶ with the correct number of zeroes and commas, then read each number aloud.
